_overview_comment: The Overview paragraphs. sunSigns, moonSigns and risingSigns are full paragraphs keyed by sign, with {name} for the first name; where one is missing or empty the shorter roleFraming + signTraits sentence is used instead. sunMoonBlend is keyed 'SunElement|MoonElement' and says how the two fit together.

sunSigns.Aries: {name} is at heart a starter. There is a need to meet life head-on, to go first, and to find out by doing rather than by waiting to be told. Energy comes in bursts and is best spent on something new; the long middle of a project is harder than its beginning, and patience is the thing learned latest.
sunSigns.Taurus: {name} is built for the long haul. What matters is what can be touched, kept and relied on: good work, good food, a place that feels solid underfoot. Change is accepted slowly and only once it has proved itself, and that same steadiness makes this one of the most dependable natures in the zodiac — and one of the hardest to hurry.
sunSigns.Gemini: {name} lives through the mind and the mouth. Curiosity is the engine: there is always another question, another angle, another person worth talking to. Boredom is the real enemy, and the gift is a lightness that can connect ideas and people who would otherwise never have met. Depth comes by choosing, now and then, to stay with one thing.
sunSigns.Cancer: {name} is moved from the inside. Feeling comes first and reasons second, and a great deal of energy goes into protecting whatever and whoever counts as home. The shell is real, but so is what it guards: a long memory, fierce loyalty, and an instinct for what other people need before they have said it.
sunSigns.Leo: {name} is here to be seen, and to give something worth seeing. There is natural warmth, a taste for the grand gesture, and a pride that does its best work when it has an audience to be generous to. Being overlooked hurts more than being criticised. At its best this is a nature that makes other people feel bigger too.
sunSigns.Virgo: {name} notices what others miss. The instinct is to sort, improve and make useful, and satisfaction comes from a job done properly rather than a job applauded. The inner critic is sharp and is usually aimed inward first. Behind the reserve sits real kindness, expressed as practical help rather than as speeches.
sunSigns.Libra: {name} thinks in pairs. Almost everything is weighed against its opposite, which gives a real sense of fairness and a gift for putting people at ease, along with some trouble deciding. Ugliness and open conflict are both felt as a kind of injury. The work of this sign is learning that keeping the peace and keeping quiet are not the same thing.
sunSigns.Scorpio: {name} does nothing by halves. Under a controlled surface there is strong feeling and a need to get to the bottom of things — people, motives, secrets, the self. Trust is given slowly and withdrawn completely. This is a nature that can go through a great deal and come out remade, and that respects only what has been tested.
sunSigns.Sagittarius: {name} needs room. The pull is always toward the bigger picture: further places, larger ideas, the meaning behind the facts. Optimism is close to a creed, and so is honesty, sometimes more of it than the moment wanted. Confinement of any kind is the thing to avoid; a far horizon and something to believe in are the things to have.
sunSigns.Capricorn: {name} plays the long game. There is a built-in sense that things worth having take time and must be earned, and a willingness to carry weight that others put down. Dry humour and real warmth tend to stay behind the working face. This is a nature that often has a serious youth and grows lighter, not heavier, with age.
sunSigns.Aquarius: {name} stands a little to one side of the crowd, the better to see it whole. Ideas matter more than conventions, and principles more than approval. There is friendliness toward everyone and closeness with few. The mind is stubborn once made up, and at its best it is put to work for something larger than one person's advantage.
sunSigns.Pisces: {name} has thin walls. Moods, atmospheres and other people's troubles come straight in, which makes for uncommon compassion and imagination and also a need to withdraw and recover. Hard edges and hard facts are not the natural language here; images, music and intuition are. The task is to stay kind without dissolving.

moonSigns.Aries: The emotional life is fast. {name} feels things at once and shows them at once, then moves on while everyone else is still catching up. What soothes is action and a degree of independence; being made to wait, or to talk a feeling to death, does the opposite.
moonSigns.Taurus: Emotionally {name} needs things to stay put. Familiar surroundings, physical comfort, enough in the cupboard and enough in the bank all do real work in keeping the mood level. Feelings are slow to rise and slow to pass, and upset shows first as stubbornness.
moonSigns.Gemini: Feelings are handled by talking about them. {name} needs company, news and variety to stay on an even keel, and tends to think a mood through rather than sit in it. Too much quiet or routine brings on restlessness; a good conversation is the cure for most things.
moonSigns.Cancer: The Moon is at home here, and so the inner life is rich and tidal. {name} takes in the mood of a room without trying, remembers how things felt years later, and looks after people as a way of feeling safe. A secure base — a home, a family of some kind — is not a luxury but a need.
moonSigns.Leo: At an instinctive level {name} needs to be appreciated. Affection should be visible and wholehearted, and is returned the same way. Being ignored wounds more deeply than it shows. When the heart is in something there is real generosity and a sense of play that draws others in.
moonSigns.Virgo: Security comes from being useful and from having things in order. Under stress {name} tidies, fixes, makes lists and worries at the details. Care is shown through practical acts rather than declarations, and it is easy to forget to extend the same patience inward.
moonSigns.Libra: Emotional balance depends a good deal on other people. {name} is at ease when the atmosphere is pleasant and relations are on good terms, and is quickly unsettled by quarrels or coldness. There is a strong instinct to smooth things over, sometimes at the cost of saying what is really felt.
moonSigns.Scorpio: The feelings run deep and are kept out of sight. {name} takes emotional matters seriously, forgets little, and wants either real closeness or none. Betrayal is the great fear and loyalty the great gift. What steadies the mood is honesty, privacy, and being trusted with the truth.
moonSigns.Sagittarius: Emotionally {name} needs space and something to look forward to. The mood lifts with movement, travel, learning and laughter, and sinks when life feels small or fenced in. There is a habit of looking on the bright side that helps in a crisis and can skip past a feeling that needed more time.
moonSigns.Capricorn: Feelings are held in check. {name} tends to cope by getting on with things, and may have learned early to rely on no one else for comfort. Respect and achievement feed a sense of safety. The warmth is real but shown sparingly, in loyalty and in being there when it counts.
moonSigns.Aquarius: The emotional style is cool and friendly rather than clinging. {name} needs a measure of freedom and some distance from which to think a feeling over, and is more comfortable with friendship than with drama. Other people's intensity can feel like a demand; shared ideas feel like closeness.
moonSigns.Pisces: The inner life is porous and impressionable. {name} absorbs other people's feelings almost as if they were personal, and needs regular retreat — sleep, music, water, time alone — to wring them out again. Sympathy comes easily, firm boundaries less so.

risingSigns.Aries: The first impression is direct and energetic. {name} walks into things quickly, says what is meant, and tends to act before the room has finished deciding. Others see confidence and some impatience.
risingSigns.Taurus: The first impression is calm and unhurried. {name} comes across as solid, pleasant and hard to rattle, with an evident liking for comfort and for doing things at a chosen pace. Others see reliability and a quiet stubbornness.
risingSigns.Gemini: The first impression is quick and talkative. {name} meets the world with questions, humour and a restless attention that moves from one thing to the next. Others see someone bright, youthful and a little hard to pin down.
risingSigns.Cancer: The first impression is gentle and somewhat guarded. {name} approaches new people and places sideways, reading the mood before committing, and warms up once it feels safe. Others see kindness and a certain shyness.
risingSigns.Leo: The first impression is warm and unmistakable. {name} has presence, carries the head high, and tends to be noticed on entering a room whether or not that was the plan. Others see confidence, generosity and a touch of theatre.
risingSigns.Virgo: The first impression is neat, modest and observant. {name} takes in the details before speaking and prefers to be helpful rather than conspicuous. Others see competence and reserve, and may miss how much is being noticed.
risingSigns.Libra: The first impression is agreeable and well presented. {name} has an easy manner, an eye for appearances, and an instinct for finding common ground. Others see charm and tact, and sometimes can't tell what is really thought.
risingSigns.Scorpio: The first impression is intent and self-contained. {name} gives little away while taking a great deal in, and has a steady gaze that some find magnetic and some unnerving. Others sense depth and know not to push.
risingSigns.Sagittarius: The first impression is open and good-humoured. {name} meets life with enthusiasm, frankness and long strides, and seems always to be on the way somewhere. Others see friendliness and an appetite for experience.
risingSigns.Capricorn: The first impression is serious and capable. {name} seems older than the years when young, keeps a certain formality, and is taken for someone who can be given responsibility. Others see reserve and dry wit, and warmth only later.
risingSigns.Aquarius: The first impression is friendly but detached. {name} is interested in everyone and beholden to no one, with a manner that is individual and sometimes deliberately out of step. Others see originality and a cool head.
risingSigns.Pisces: The first impression is soft and hard to define. {name} adapts to the surroundings, listens well, and gives off a dreamy or sympathetic quality that draws confidences. Others see gentleness, and each tends to see something different.

sunMoonBlend.Fire|Fire: Sun and Moon are both in fire signs, so what is wanted and what is needed speak the same language: act, enjoy, move on. There is little inner argument and plenty of spirit — and not much built-in brake.
sunMoonBlend.Fire|Earth: A fire Sun with an earth Moon: the will runs ahead while the instincts ask for something solid. When the two cooperate, enthusiasm gets finished and paid for; when they don't, there is a tug between adventure and security.
sunMoonBlend.Fire|Air: A fire Sun with an air Moon is a lively, sociable mix. Ideas feed the enthusiasm and enthusiasm gives the ideas somewhere to go. Feelings are kept light and moving, and stillness takes practice.
sunMoonBlend.Fire|Water: A fire Sun with a water Moon: a confident, outgoing will sits on top of a far more sensitive inner life than people expect. The warmth is real on both levels, but moods can dampen the drive, or the drive can ride over the moods.
sunMoonBlend.Earth|Fire: An earth Sun with a fire Moon: a practical, steady purpose with an impatient heart underneath. The instincts want excitement and quick results while the conscious self insists on doing things properly. Together they make someone who works hard and needs it to matter.
sunMoonBlend.Earth|Earth: Sun and Moon are both in earth signs, so purpose and instinct agree: be useful, be secure, deal with what is real. This is a settled, capable combination that can find change and the intangible genuinely uncomfortable.
sunMoonBlend.Earth|Air: An earth Sun with an air Moon: the aims are practical, but the emotional life runs on talk, ideas and company. It makes for a level head and a certain coolness, with feelings examined at arm's length rather than wallowed in.
sunMoonBlend.Earth|Water: An earth Sun with a water Moon is a naturally fertile mix. Practical ability is fed by real feeling, and the feeling is given something solid to hold on to. Caring is shown by providing. The risk is caution on both counts.
sunMoonBlend.Air|Fire: An air Sun with a fire Moon: a thinking, sociable nature with quick, warm instincts. Reactions come fast and are usually expressed, which keeps things honest. It is an easy combination to live with and a hard one to slow down.
sunMoonBlend.Air|Earth: An air Sun with an earth Moon: the mind likes possibilities, while the instincts want routine and results. At its best ideas are made to work in practice. At other times the head wonders why the body will not come along.
sunMoonBlend.Air|Air: Sun and Moon are both in air signs, so thought and feeling use the same vocabulary. Experience is understood by talking it through, and relationships are built on shared ideas. Raw, wordless emotion — one's own or other people's — is the unfamiliar country.
sunMoonBlend.Air|Water: An air Sun with a water Moon: a reasonable, communicative surface over an inner life that is not reasonable at all. The mind may explain feelings away while they carry on regardless. When the two are on speaking terms there is both insight and the words for it.
sunMoonBlend.Water|Fire: A water Sun with a fire Moon: a sensitive, private purpose with hot, impatient reactions. Feelings are both deep and quick to flare, which makes for strong passion and the occasional storm. What helps is somewhere to put all that energy.
sunMoonBlend.Water|Earth: A water Sun with an earth Moon is steadying. The sensitivity of the Sun is given a calm, practical base, so feelings are contained rather than spilled. Loyalty and care for a small circle of people come naturally.
sunMoonBlend.Water|Air: A water Sun with an air Moon: the nature is feeling at the core, but the instinct under stress is to step back and think. It lends some useful perspective on strong emotions, and can also look like blowing warm and cool by turns.
sunMoonBlend.Water|Water: Sun and Moon are both in water signs, so the whole nature runs on feeling. Empathy, intuition and imagination are strong; so is the pull of mood. Privacy and time alone are needed, and so is someone trusted enough to be let in.

planetInSign.Chiron|Pisces: The tender spot is the world's suffering, felt as one's own; healing comes through compassion that has learned where it ends
planetInSign.Lilith|Aries: The untamed streak shows as fierce independence and an anger that will not be made polite
planetInSign.Lilith|Taurus: The untamed streak shows in appetite and ownership: a refusal to apologise for pleasure, the body, or wanting to have
planetInSign.Lilith|Gemini: The untamed streak shows in speech: saying the unsayable, a sharp tongue, and a mind that will not be told what to think
planetInSign.Lilith|Cancer: The untamed streak shows around family and mothering: a refusal of the nurturing role as it was handed down
planetInSign.Lilith|Leo: The untamed streak shows in pride and desire for attention, a magnetism that will not dim itself to be acceptable
planetInSign.Lilith|Virgo: The untamed streak shows in the pull between purity and sensuality, and a refusal to be merely useful
planetInSign.Lilith|Libra: The untamed streak shows in relationships: a refusal to keep the peace at the cost of the self
planetInSign.Lilith|Scorpio: The untamed streak shows as raw intensity around sex, power and taboo, with nothing held back and nothing forgiven lightly
planetInSign.Lilith|Sagittarius: The untamed streak shows as a refusal of dogma and any fence, with a hunger for freedom that can turn restless
planetInSign.Lilith|Capricorn: The untamed streak shows in ambition and in a quarrel with authority: a will to power on one's own terms
planetInSign.Lilith|Aquarius: The untamed streak shows as rebellion: the born outsider who will not join, even when the group is right
planetInSign.Lilith|Pisces: The untamed streak shows in fantasy and surrender, an elusive quality that slips out of every definition

_planetInHouse_comment: The house sentence that follows each Planet-in-Sign line when the birth time is known, keyed 'Planet|House' (1 to 12). Full sentences. A missing or empty entry falls back to 'This colours <houseAreas>.'

planetInHouse.Sun|1: With the Sun rising, personality and purpose are the same thing: what is seen is what is there, and life is approached as a personal project.
planetInHouse.Sun|2: Here the sense of self is tied to what is earned and owned. Building security, and finding out what is really worth having, is central to the life.
planetInHouse.Sun|3: The Sun shines through the mind and the voice. Learning, writing, talking, and the ties with siblings and neighbours are where this person comes alive.
planetInHouse.Sun|4: At the foot of the chart the Sun points inward. Home, family and private roots matter more than public standing, and much of life's meaning is found there.
planetInHouse.Sun|5: This is a creative, playful placing. Self-expression, romance, children and whatever is done purely for the love of it lie close to the heart of things.
planetInHouse.Sun|6: Purpose is found in work and in being of use. Daily routine, skill and health absorb much of the energy, and pride is taken in doing a job well.
planetInHouse.Sun|7: Life is lived largely through partnership. Other people act as the mirror in which the self comes into focus, and important chapters begin with a meeting.
planetInHouse.Sun|8: The Sun here is drawn below the surface: to intimacy, shared money, crisis and renewal. Identity is forged by what has been gone through.
planetInHouse.Sun|9: This is a searching placing. Travel, study, belief and the wide world call strongly, and the self is found by going further than where it started.
planetInHouse.Sun|10: At the top of the chart the Sun asks to be visible. Career, reputation and achievement matter, and there is a wish to stand for something in public.
planetInHouse.Sun|11: The Sun shines among friends and in groups. Ideals, causes and plans for the future give direction, and much is achieved with and through others.
planetInHouse.Sun|12: Hidden in the twelfth, the Sun works behind the scenes. Solitude, inner life and service are needed, and the ego is quieter than the sign alone suggests.
planetInHouse.Moon|1: The feelings sit on the surface. Moods show in the face, and this person responds to the surroundings instinctively and visibly.
planetInHouse.Moon|2: Emotional security and material security are closely linked: having enough, and having familiar things around, keeps the mood steady.
planetInHouse.Moon|3: Feelings look for words. There is a need to talk, write and be in touch, and the mind is coloured by mood; early surroundings and siblings leave a deep mark.
planetInHouse.Moon|4: The Moon is in its own house here. Home and family are the emotional anchor, the past is never far away, and a private place of retreat is essential.
planetInHouse.Moon|5: The heart is in play, romance and creative things. There is a fondness for children and an emotional need to make something of one's own.
planetInHouse.Moon|6: Feelings are bound up with daily routine and work. The body reacts quickly to worry, and looking after others in practical ways brings comfort.
planetInHouse.Moon|7: Emotional needs are met through partnership. There is a strong instinct to respond to others, and a tendency to feel incomplete when alone.
planetInHouse.Moon|8: The emotional life runs deep and private. Feelings are intense, bonds are all or nothing, and there is an instinct for what others leave unsaid.
planetInHouse.Moon|9: The Moon is restless here, at home in foreign places and big ideas. A belief to live by is an emotional need, and so is the freedom to go looking for one.
planetInHouse.Moon|10: Feelings are on public view. There is a need to be recognised, an instinct for what the public wants, and a career that may change with the tides.
planetInHouse.Moon|11: Friends are family. Emotional nourishment comes from belonging to a circle or a cause, and hopes for the future shift as the feelings do.
planetInHouse.Moon|12: The feelings are kept well hidden, sometimes even from their owner. Time alone is a real need, and there is a quiet sensitivity to those who suffer.
planetInHouse.Mercury|1: The mind is the calling card: quick, questioning and talkative, with thoughts voiced almost as soon as they arrive.
planetInHouse.Mercury|2: Thinking turns to practical value. There is a head for figures and trade, and a living may be made by wits, words or skill with the hands.
planetInHouse.Mercury|3: Mercury is at home here. The mind is busy, curious and well informed, and comes into its own in writing, teaching, and everyday exchange.
planetInHouse.Mercury|4: Thought turns homeward and backward: to family, history and private study. Much of the real thinking is done at home, away from other voices.
planetInHouse.Mercury|5: The mind plays. There is wit, a storyteller's gift, a taste for games and puzzles, and pleasure in putting ideas across with some style.
planetInHouse.Mercury|6: This is a precise, practical mind, good with method, detail and technique. It also worries, and the nerves are quick to report overwork.
planetInHouse.Mercury|7: Thinking is done in dialogue. Ideas are sharpened against other people, and a partner who can talk is worth more than one who can't.
planetInHouse.Mercury|8: The mind digs. Research, psychology, finance and anything concealed hold the interest, and little is taken at face value.
planetInHouse.Mercury|9: The mind ranges far, toward philosophy, languages, law and foreign places. There is a lifelong student here, and often a natural teacher.
planetInHouse.Mercury|10: Words and ideas are put to public use. Career is likely to involve speaking, writing or planning, and a reputation is made by what is said.
planetInHouse.Mercury|11: Thinking is social and forward-looking. Ideas are exchanged among friends and in groups, and the company kept is chosen for its conversation.
planetInHouse.Mercury|12: The mind works quietly and by intuition. Much is thought and little is said, and solitude or sleep brings the clearest ideas.
planetInHouse.Venus|1: Charm is worn on the outside. There is a pleasing manner, a care for appearance, and an ease that makes others well disposed from the start.
planetInHouse.Venus|2: Venus enjoys what it can own. There is a love of good things, some luck with money, and a tendency to spend it on comfort and beauty.
planetInHouse.Venus|3: Affection is expressed in words. There is grace in speech and writing, a liking for pleasant company close to home, and warm ties with siblings.
planetInHouse.Venus|4: Love is centred on home and family. A beautiful, peaceful place to live matters greatly, and the later years tend to be comfortable.
planetInHouse.Venus|5: This is among the most romantic placings: a love of courtship, pleasure, art and children, and a gift for enjoying life.
planetInHouse.Venus|6: Affection is shown by helping. Pleasant working conditions and good relations with colleagues matter, and love may be met through work.
planetInHouse.Venus|7: Venus is at home in the house of partnership. Relationship is sought and valued, harmony with others comes readily, and marriage tends to bring benefits.
planetInHouse.Venus|8: Love is intense and bound up with trust. Venus here wants depth rather than pleasantness, and may gain through a partner's resources or through inheritance.
planetInHouse.Venus|9: There is a love of travel, learning and foreign cultures. Attraction is often to someone from a different background, or to a meeting of minds.
planetInHouse.Venus|10: Charm works in public. Venus here favours careers in the arts, diplomacy or anything requiring popularity, and gives a liking for status and good opinion.
planetInHouse.Venus|11: Friendship is the natural form of love. There are many pleasant connections, help comes through friends, and love often begins in a shared circle.
planetInHouse.Venus|12: Love is private and sometimes secret. There is deep compassion, a taste for solitude and quiet beauty, and feelings that are kept rather than declared.
planetInHouse.Mars|1: Mars rising gives an assertive, physical, competitive manner. This is someone who acts first, likes to lead, and is rarely ignored.
planetInHouse.Mars|2: Energy goes into earning. There is real drive to make money and a readiness to fight for what is owned, and spending can be as impulsive as the getting.
planetInHouse.Mars|3: The mind and tongue are sharp. Opinions are stated with force, argument is enjoyed, and there is restless energy for short journeys and quick projects.
planetInHouse.Mars|4: A great deal of energy is spent at home, on the house or within the family, where tempers can also run high. Underneath is a strong will to secure a base.
planetInHouse.Mars|5: Mars plays to win. There is passion in love, enthusiasm for sport and competition, and a bold, physical kind of creativity.
planetInHouse.Mars|6: This is a tireless worker who needs to be busy and does not suffer inefficiency gladly. Health is best served by regular hard exercise.
planetInHouse.Mars|7: Energy goes into relationships, and so does combativeness. Strong, assertive partners are attracted, and cooperation has to be learned through some friction.
planetInHouse.Mars|8: Desire is strong and willpower considerable. Mars here meets crises head-on, and can be drawn into conflicts over shared money or control.
planetInHouse.Mars|9: There is a crusading streak: strong convictions, eagerness for travel and adventure, and a readiness to fight for a belief.
planetInHouse.Mars|10: Ambition is direct and energetic. Mars near the top of the chart wants to get to the top of something, and works hard and competitively to do it.
planetInHouse.Mars|11: Energy is spent with friends and for causes. This person stirs groups into action, and may quarrel with the same friends along the way.
planetInHouse.Mars|12: The drive works out of sight. Anger is often held in or turned inward, and the most effective efforts are those made alone or behind the scenes.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|1: Jupiter rising gives an open, confident, generous manner, and a faith that things will turn out well, which often enough makes them do so.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|2: This is a fortunate placing for money. Resources tend to come easily and to be spent just as freely, with real generosity.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|3: The mind is broad, optimistic and fond of learning. There is ease in talking to anyone, and good fortune through siblings, neighbours and short journeys.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|4: There is good fortune through home and family. A generous upbringing or a spacious home is suggested, and contentment tends to grow in later life.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|5: Enjoyment comes naturally. Jupiter here is generous in love, lucky in play, creative on a large scale, and often blessed in children.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|6: Work is a source of growth and satisfaction. Colleagues are well disposed and health is generally sound, with overindulgence the main thing to watch.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|7: Benefit comes through other people. Partnership tends to be fortunate and partners generous, and there is a talent for good-natured cooperation.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|8: Gain comes through shared resources, a partner's means, or inheritance, and there is a hopeful resilience in the face of loss and change.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|9: Jupiter is in its own house. A love of travel, philosophy and higher learning runs through the life, with faith and good fortune far from home.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|10: This is a promising placing for career. Recognition comes, people in authority are helpful, and reputation tends to be a good one.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|11: Friends are many and useful. Jupiter here gives large hopes that are often realised through the goodwill of a wide circle.
planetInHouse.Jupiter|12: The good fortune is of the hidden kind: help arriving at the last moment, an inner faith, and generosity done without an audience.
planetInHouse.Saturn|1: Saturn rising gives a serious, self-controlled manner and a cautious approach to life. Confidence comes slowly and is solid when it arrives.
planetInHouse.Saturn|2: Money is treated carefully. There may be early anxieties about having enough; what is earned comes through steady effort and is kept.
planetInHouse.Saturn|3: The mind is methodical and thorough rather than quick. Early schooling may have been a struggle, and words are chosen with care.
planetInHouse.Saturn|4: Home and family bring responsibility, and perhaps a strict or burdened childhood. There is a deep need to build a secure base by one's own effort.
planetInHouse.Saturn|5: Pleasure does not come lightly. There can be shyness in love and self-consciousness in creative work, and children are taken as a serious trust.
planetInHouse.Saturn|6: This is a conscientious worker who takes on duties and carries them. Routine is taken seriously, and health needs steady, sensible attention.
planetInHouse.Saturn|7: Partnership is approached cautiously and taken seriously. Commitment may come late or to someone older, and a bond once made is expected to last.
planetInHouse.Saturn|8: There are responsibilities over shared money and a wariness about emotional and physical closeness. Deep trust is built slowly.
planetInHouse.Saturn|9: Beliefs are tested rather than assumed. There is respect for tradition and learning, and a philosophy worked out carefully over many years.
planetInHouse.Saturn|10: Saturn is strong at the top of the chart. Ambition is serious and patient, authority is earned by degrees, and a fall follows any shortcut.
planetInHouse.Saturn|11: Friends are few, older or long-standing. Group commitments are honoured dutifully, and hopes are realised late and by persistence.
planetInHouse.Saturn|12: The fears are private ones, and so is the strength. Much is carried alone, and peace is found in solitude, discipline, and quiet service.
planetInHouse.Uranus|1: Uranus rising marks an unmistakable individual: independent, unconventional, and inclined to do the unexpected.
planetInHouse.Uranus|2: Finances are irregular, with sudden gains and reverses. Income may come from unusual sources, and freedom is valued above possessions.
planetInHouse.Uranus|3: The mind is original and intuitive and thinks in sudden leaps. Ordinary schooling may have chafed, and opinions are rarely the standard ones.
planetInHouse.Uranus|4: Home life is unsettled or unconventional. There may have been upheaval in the family, many moves, or a need to break with the background.
planetInHouse.Uranus|5: Love affairs begin and end suddenly, and creative work is original. There is a need for freedom in pleasure, and an unusual way with children.
planetInHouse.Uranus|6: Routine is hard to bear. Uranus here needs freedom in how the work is done, brings invention to methods, and makes the nerves sensitive to strain.
planetInHouse.Uranus|7: Relationships are unconventional. Independent or unusual partners are attracted, and room to breathe within any partnership is essential.
planetInHouse.Uranus|8: Changes in shared finances or in life's direction come without warning. There is an interest in what lies beneath, and transformations happen fast.
planetInHouse.Uranus|9: Beliefs are progressive and personal. Orthodox teaching is rejected, and travel or study brings unexpected, mind-changing experiences.
planetInHouse.Uranus|10: The career follows no straight line. Uranus here suits independent or unusual work, resists being managed, and may change direction abruptly.
planetInHouse.Uranus|11: Uranus is at home among friends and causes. The circle is varied and unconventional, and the hopes held for the future are reforming ones.
planetInHouse.Uranus|12: The rebellion is an inner one. There are flashes of intuition from somewhere below thought, and a need to free oneself from hidden restraints.
planetInHouse.Neptune|1: Neptune rising gives a gentle, impressionable, hard-to-define presence. Others tend to see what they wish to see, and the self-image is fluid.
planetInHouse.Neptune|2: Money slips through the fingers. Values are idealistic rather than material, and practical matters of income need a clear eye.
planetInHouse.Neptune|3: The mind is imaginative, visual and intuitive. There is a gift for poetry or music, alongside some vagueness about facts and arrangements.
planetInHouse.Neptune|4: Home and family are idealised, or were uncertain in some way. There is a longing for a perfect place of retreat, perhaps near water.
planetInHouse.Neptune|5: Love is romantic and idealised, and creative imagination is strong. This placing favours the arts and theatre, and warns of illusion in romance.
planetInHouse.Neptune|6: Work has an element of service or sacrifice. The body is sensitive, to medicines and atmospheres alike, and ordinary routine is hard to hold on to.
planetInHouse.Neptune|7: Partners are seen through a haze of idealism. There is a search for a soulmate, a readiness to give much, and a need to see others as they are.
planetInHouse.Neptune|8: There is a psychic sensitivity to undercurrents, and a need for clarity in joint finances, where matters can become confused.
planetInHouse.Neptune|9: Faith is mystical rather than doctrinal. There is a longing for distant places and for a truth that goes beyond what reason can supply.
planetInHouse.Neptune|10: The vocation may be artistic, healing or idealistic, and its course unclear for a time. The public image has glamour, and can attract projection.
planetInHouse.Neptune|11: The hopes are idealistic and humanitarian. Friends may be artistic or spiritual, and discrimination is needed about who is really to be trusted.
planetInHouse.Neptune|12: Neptune is at home in the twelfth. The inner life is rich and the compassion deep, and regular withdrawal is needed to stay clear.
planetInHouse.Pluto|1: Pluto rising gives an intense, forceful presence and a powerful will. Life brings periods of complete personal reinvention.
planetInHouse.Pluto|2: There are strong feelings about money and possession. Resources may be lost and rebuilt, and with them the understanding of what has real worth.
planetInHouse.Pluto|3: The mind is penetrating and persuasive. Opinions are held strongly, words carry weight, and there is a need to get to the bottom of things.
planetInHouse.Pluto|4: The roots run deep and may be tangled. A powerful family influence or early upheaval is suggested, and the inner foundations are rebuilt over time.
planetInHouse.Pluto|5: Love affairs are intense and transforming, and creative power is considerable. Play is serious, and there is a strong will where children are concerned.
planetInHouse.Pluto|6: Work is approached with total commitment, sometimes obsession. There is an ability to overhaul methods, and to regenerate health after a setback.
planetInHouse.Pluto|7: Relationships change the life. Powerful partners are attracted, and questions of control have to be worked through together.
planetInHouse.Pluto|8: Pluto is in its own house. There is depth, resilience in crisis, strong desire, and an understanding of loss and renewal learned at first hand.
planetInHouse.Pluto|9: Beliefs are held with conviction and may be completely overturned and rebuilt. Travel or study has a transforming effect.
planetInHouse.Pluto|10: There is a drive for power and influence in the world. The career may go through a complete end and new beginning, and authority is wanted or contested.
planetInHouse.Pluto|11: Friendships are intense and few. Pluto here works to change things through groups, and finds its aims transformed along the way.
planetInHouse.Pluto|12: The power is hidden, working in the unconscious. Old buried material comes up to be dealt with, and great inner strength is found in solitude.
planetInHouse.North Node|1: The path leads toward independence: developing a self of one's own rather than leaning on a partner.
planetInHouse.North Node|2: The path leads toward self-sufficiency: earning one's own way and building on values that are truly one's own.
planetInHouse.North Node|3: The path leads toward the everyday world of learning and talk: asking questions rather than preaching answers.
planetInHouse.North Node|4: The path leads homeward: toward family, inner life and emotional roots, and away from living only for the career.
planetInHouse.North Node|5: The path leads toward personal creativity and the heart, and away from hiding in the crowd.
planetInHouse.North Node|6: The path leads toward useful daily work and care of the body, and away from drifting or escape.
planetInHouse.North Node|7: The path leads toward partnership: learning to cooperate, share and see through another's eyes.
planetInHouse.North Node|8: The path leads toward real intimacy and shared resources, and away from holding on to what is safely one's own.
planetInHouse.North Node|9: The path leads outward, to travel, study and a wider philosophy, and away from the merely local and factual.
planetInHouse.North Node|10: The path leads into the world: taking up a public role and its responsibilities rather than staying safely at home.
planetInHouse.North Node|11: The path leads toward friends, groups and shared ideals, and away from the need to be the centre of attention.
planetInHouse.North Node|12: The path leads inward: toward solitude, faith and letting go, and away from fretting over every detail.
planetInHouse.Chiron|1: The wound touches identity itself: an early sense of being somehow wrong, which later makes this person a real encouragement to others.
planetInHouse.Chiron|2: The wound touches worth and security. Self-value has to be built from within rather than counted in possessions.
planetInHouse.Chiron|3: The wound touches communication and learning: once not being heard, perhaps, and later a gift for helping others find their words.
planetInHouse.Chiron|4: The wound lies in the family or the early home. Making a place of real belonging is both the difficulty and the gift.
planetInHouse.Chiron|5: The wound touches play, creativity and being loved for oneself. Encouraging these things in others comes more easily than claiming them.
planetInHouse.Chiron|6: The wound shows in health or in work. There is often a gift for healing and service that was learned through personal difficulty.
planetInHouse.Chiron|7: The wound is met in relationship. Others arrive bringing both the hurt and the healing, and there is skill in counselling them.
planetInHouse.Chiron|8: The wound concerns loss, intimacy and trust. Having been through the dark, this person can sit with others in theirs.
planetInHouse.Chiron|9: The wound concerns faith and meaning. A broken belief is replaced by a hard-won wisdom worth passing on.
planetInHouse.Chiron|10: The wound is carried in public, in the career or the standing. Authority comes through what was overcome rather than what was given.
planetInHouse.Chiron|11: The wound is one of not belonging. The outsider's view becomes a gift to whatever group is eventually found.
planetInHouse.Chiron|12: The wound is old and hard to name, as if inherited. Compassion for hidden suffering runs deep, and solitude heals.
planetInHouse.Lilith|1: This shows in the person directly: a provocative, uncompromising quality that others notice at once.
planetInHouse.Lilith|2: It is felt around money, the body and ownership, with fierce insistence on depending on no one.
planetInHouse.Lilith|3: It comes out in speech and thought, in saying what was not supposed to be said.
planetInHouse.Lilith|4: It lies at the root, in a family story of what was shut out or not spoken about.
planetInHouse.Lilith|5: It comes out in desire, creativity and play, pursued without asking permission.
planetInHouse.Lilith|6: It is felt in work and the body, as a refusal of servitude and of routines imposed by others.
planetInHouse.Lilith|7: It is met in partners, or projected onto them, and brings a struggle over who holds the power.
planetInHouse.Lilith|8: It is at its most intense here, in sexuality, shared resources, and the things people fear.
planetInHouse.Lilith|9: It turns against received belief, and insists on finding its own truth by its own road.
planetInHouse.Lilith|10: It is on public view, as a reputation for defiance or a refusal of the expected role.
planetInHouse.Lilith|11: It plays out in groups, as the one who does not fit and will not pretend to.
planetInHouse.Lilith|12: It is buried in the unconscious, surfacing in dreams and in what is denied.

_retrogrades_comment: Added to a planet's line when it was retrograde at birth, keyed by planet.

retrogrades.Mercury: Mercury was retrograde at birth: the mind turns things over before speaking, and often thinks along lines of its own.
retrogrades.Venus: Venus was retrograde at birth, which is uncommon: affection is felt deeply but shown with reserve, and values are worked out privately rather than borrowed.
retrogrades.Mars: Mars was retrograde at birth: the drive is held back and considered before it is released, and anger is slow to show.
retrogrades.Jupiter: Jupiter was retrograde at birth: growth and faith are sought within, by a standard that is personal rather than conventional.
retrogrades.Saturn: Saturn was retrograde at birth: the discipline is self-imposed, and the sternest authority is the inner one.
retrogrades.Uranus: Uranus was retrograde at birth: the urge to be free works inwardly first, as a change of mind before a change of life.
retrogrades.Neptune: Neptune was retrograde at birth: the ideals and the imagination are kept private, an inner world more than a public one.
retrogrades.Pluto: Pluto was retrograde at birth, as it is for nearly half of every year: the deepest changes are made inwardly and quietly.
retrogrades.Chiron: Chiron was retrograde at birth: the old wound is worked on from the inside, by reflection more than by action.
