_aspects_comment: Bespoke lines for the major aspects in the birth chart, keyed 'Point|Tone|Point'. Tone is Conjunction, Flow (sextile or trine) or Tension (square or opposition). The two points are always in standard order (Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, Pluto, North Node, Chiron, Lilith, Ascendant, Midheaven), so each pair has one line: 'Sun|Flow|Moon', never 'Moon|Flow|Sun'. Covered: every pair among the thirteen bodies that can occur, and each body with the Ascendant and Midheaven. An empty line gets a plainer sentence built from planetThemes / angleThemes and aspectToneLinks, followed by the aspectNotes line. Minor aspects always use aspectNotes.

aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Moon: Born near a New Moon: will and feeling point the same way, which gives singleness of purpose and a strongly subjective outlook. It is hard to stand back and see oneself as others do.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Moon: What is wanted and what is needed are on good terms. There is an inner ease, a sense of being comfortable in one's own skin, that carries over into dealings with other people.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Moon: What is wanted and what is needed pull different ways, so there is an inner restlessness that drives a good deal of effort. Contentment comes from giving both sides a turn rather than letting one win.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Mercury: Mind and identity are closely joined. Opinions are held personally and expressed readily, and seeing a matter from outside one's own position takes a deliberate effort.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Venus: Charm and a wish to please are part of the character. There is a love of beauty and comfort and a real gift for affection, with some reluctance to do anything disagreeable.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Mars: Energy, courage and will are fused. This is a forceful, competitive nature that needs hard physical or practical outlets, and that can run to impatience and overwork.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Mars: Vitality is strong and easily put to use. Decisions turn into action without much fuss, and there is the confidence to take a lead.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Mars: There is a great deal of drive and a short fuse. Effort tends to be made against resistance, real or imagined, and learning to pick the battles saves much energy.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Jupiter: An expansive, optimistic nature with faith in itself and in life. Generosity and good fortune go with it, and so does a tendency to promise or attempt too much.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Jupiter: Confidence and goodwill come naturally, and opportunities tend to appear without being chased. The only risk in so easy a contact is coasting.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Jupiter: Enthusiasm outruns judgment. There is real largeness of spirit here, along with a habit of overestimating, overspending or overdoing that needs a steadying hand.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Saturn: A serious, self-disciplined character, often shaped by early responsibility or a demanding father. Confidence is built slowly, by achievement, and lasts.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Saturn: Purpose and patience work together. There is a practical, organised approach, respect for experience, and the staying power to finish what is started.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Saturn: Self-doubt and a sense of obstacles weigh on the will, especially when young. What it produces in the end is unusual persistence and a success that owes nothing to luck.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Uranus: A strongly individual, independent nature that cannot be made to conform. Life tends to proceed by sudden changes, and originality is the keynote.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Uranus: Originality comes without strain. There is an inventive, forward-looking streak and the ability to make changes at the right moment and take others along.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Uranus: The need for freedom is urgent and sometimes disruptive. Restlessness and a dislike of being told make for an erratic course until the independence finds a constructive use.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Neptune: Imagination and sensitivity colour the whole character. There is something of the artist, dreamer or idealist, and the sense of self has soft edges.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Neptune: Imagination and compassion are readily available and can be given form. Many musicians, artists and healers have this quiet, receptive contact.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Neptune: It is hard to see oneself clearly. Ideals are high and disillusion is a risk, as are confusion about direction and a tendency to evade; creative or spiritual work gives the sensitivity its proper outlet.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Pluto: A powerful will and a need to live intensely. The character goes through deep changes and remakes itself more than once, and does not do well under anyone's control.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Pluto: There are deep reserves to draw on. The capacity to concentrate, recover and start again is strong, and influence is exerted without force.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Pluto: Questions of power run through the life, whether in clashes with authority or in a compulsive need to control. The same intensity, once understood, gives formidable determination.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Mercury: Thought and feeling are hard to separate. The mind is quick, responsive and sympathetic, with a good memory, and opinions shift with mood.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Mercury: Feelings are put into words without difficulty. This gives common sense, a retentive memory and an easy way of talking to all kinds of people.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Mercury: Head and heart interrupt one another. There is nervous quickness and a tendency to worry or talk for the sake of it, and it helps to notice when a feeling is being argued with rather than felt.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Venus: An affectionate, gentle disposition with a love of comfort and pleasant company. There is natural grace in dealing with people, and popularity comes without trying.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Venus: Warmth is given and received easily. This is a sociable, good-natured contact that favours domestic happiness and an eye for what looks and feels right.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Venus: The need to be loved is strong and not easily satisfied. Affection may be sought through pleasing or indulgence, and comfort and closeness sometimes pull in different directions.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Mars: Feelings are strong, quick and acted on. There is courage and directness in the emotional life, along with a temper and a dislike of being crossed.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Mars: Emotional energy is plentiful and well used. Reactions are honest and prompt, and there is the vigour to defend what is cared about.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Mars: The moods are combative. Irritation flares easily, particularly at home, and others may find the reactions sharper than was meant. Physical activity is the best release.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Jupiter: A generous, kindly, hopeful emotional nature. Feelings are large and openly shown, and there is a protective instinct toward anyone in need.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Jupiter: Good humour and goodwill are close to the surface. Others are put at ease, and there is a basic trust in life that tends to be rewarded.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Jupiter: The feelings overflow. Generosity can turn to extravagance and sympathy to overreaction, and moods swing between elation and letdown.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Saturn: The emotions are controlled and cautious. There may have been early loneliness or duty; in return there is loyalty, a sense of responsibility, and emotional self-reliance.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Saturn: Feeling is steadied by common sense. This gives reliability, thrift, patience and a calm way of dealing with family and practical matters.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Saturn: It is hard to feel at ease or to ask for comfort. A reserved or critical atmosphere early on leaves a tendency to low moods and self-denial, which lifts as security is built by one's own effort.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Uranus: The emotional life is highly charged and unpredictable. There is strong intuition, a need for stimulation, and a refusal to be tied down by routine or convention.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Uranus: The instincts are quick, original and open to the new. Change is taken in good part, and friendships tend to be unusual and stimulating.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Uranus: Feelings change abruptly, and with them the domestic arrangements. There is a restless, highly strung quality and a fear of being trapped that can unsettle close ties.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Neptune: The feelings are fine-tuned to the point of being psychic. Imagination, sympathy and a love of music or the sea go with this, as does a tendency to daydream.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Neptune: There is a gentle, imaginative, intuitive quality to the emotional life. Sympathy is real and unforced, and artistic appreciation is strong.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Neptune: Feelings and facts blur. This person is easily moved and easily misled, may idealise home or mother, and needs to check impressions before acting on them.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Pluto: The emotions are intense, private and all-consuming. There are powerful attachments, perhaps a dominating maternal influence, and periodic complete changes in the inner life.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Pluto: Emotional depth without the turmoil. Feelings are strong and lasting, and there is a capacity to renew oneself and to support others through crisis.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Pluto: Feelings build under pressure and then break out. Jealousy, possessiveness or old family tensions may have to be faced and cleared before peace of mind is possible.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Venus: The mind has charm. Speech and writing are graceful, there is a liking for the arts and for agreeable conversation, and differences are settled with tact.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Venus: There is ease and pleasantness in expression. This favours a good voice, a sense of design, and a cheerful, diplomatic way with words.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Mars: A sharp, quick, argumentative mind. Thoughts are turned straight into speech or action, and there is skill in debate and in anything needing fast decisions.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Mars: The mind is energetic and practical. Ideas are acted on, speech is direct and effective, and there is often mechanical or technical aptitude.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Mars: The tongue is quicker than the judgment. There is mental energy to spare, shown in sharpness, haste and a readiness to argue; the cure is to pause before replying.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Jupiter: A broad, optimistic mind with plenty to say. Interests are wide, and there is a gift for seeing the general principle, though details can be passed over.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Jupiter: Good judgment and a cheerful intelligence. Learning comes easily, and so do teaching, travel, and the ability to explain large ideas plainly.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Jupiter: The mind bites off more than it can chew. There is a tendency to exaggerate, to promise too much or to overlook the fine print, alongside real breadth of interest.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Saturn: A serious, orderly, careful mind. Thought is logical and thorough, speech is economical, and the outlook may lean toward the pessimistic.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Saturn: Concentration and method come naturally. This is a contact for exact, patient mental work, sound planning and a good memory for facts.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Saturn: Thinking is hampered by doubt or fear of being wrong. Early difficulties with learning or speech are possible, and are often answered later by real depth and rigour.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Uranus: A brilliant, original, independent mind that grasps things in flashes. It is impatient with slower thinkers and with received opinion.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Uranus: The mind is inventive and intuitive. There is aptitude for science, technology or anything new, and a knack for the unexpected solution.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Uranus: The thinking is quick, eccentric and contrary. Nervous tension runs high, opinions are blurted, and ideas change before they have been carried through.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Neptune: The mind works in images. There is imagination, a feeling for poetry and music, and intuition in place of logic; facts and fancies need to be kept apart.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Neptune: Imagination and reason cooperate. This gives a subtle, perceptive mind, good at conveying moods and at reading what is not said.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Neptune: Clear thinking is clouded by wishful thinking. There is forgetfulness, vagueness or a tendency to evade the plain fact, and also a real creative fantasy that needs a disciplined form.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Pluto: A penetrating mind that wants the whole truth. There is a gift for research and persuasion, and a tendency to hold opinions with obsessive force.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Pluto: The mind goes deep without strain. Concentration is excellent, and there is an ability to analyse, investigate and get to the point.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Pluto: Thought is intense and inclined to suspicion. Words are used as weapons, or as tools to dig out what is hidden; it is a strong mind that needs to learn to let a subject go.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Mars: Affection and desire are one. This is a warm, passionate, attractive nature, quick to fall in love, with a strong creative impulse.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Mars: Giving and wanting are in balance. Relations with the opposite sex are easy, and there is vitality in artistic and social life.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Mars: Love and desire are at odds. Attractions are strong and stormy, tenderness and assertiveness take turns, and relationships have friction as well as spark.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Jupiter: A generous, warm-hearted, pleasure-loving nature. This is a fortunate contact for popularity and comfort, with a leaning toward indulgence.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Jupiter: Good nature and good luck in affection. There is grace, generosity and enjoyment of life, and benefits often come through other people.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Jupiter: Too much of a good thing. Affection is lavish but may be spread thin, and extravagance, vanity or laziness need watching.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Saturn: Love is taken seriously. Affection is constant and dutiful rather than demonstrative; there may be shyness, delay in love, or attachment to someone older.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Saturn: Loyalty and good sense steady the affections. Relationships are lasting, there is thrift with money, and a liking for form and structure in the arts.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Saturn: There is a fear of not being lovable. Feelings are held back, disappointment is expected, and affection has to get past a good deal of caution; what is eventually given is faithful.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Uranus: Love is exciting and unconventional. Attractions are sudden and magnetic, and freedom within relationship is insisted on. Taste is original.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Uranus: There is sparkle in the affections. Friendships are many and unusual, love has an element of the unexpected, and artistic talent runs to the modern.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Uranus: Affections are unstable. Attractions begin suddenly and end the same way, and the wish for closeness fights the wish to be free.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Neptune: Love is idealised. The romantic imagination is strong, as is the feeling for music and art, and partners are liable to be seen as more than they are.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Neptune: Tenderness, refinement and artistic sensibility. Affection has a selfless, compassionate quality, and beauty is felt keenly.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Neptune: Romance is clouded by illusion. There is a longing for a perfect love that real people cannot supply, which can lead to disappointment or to sacrifice for the unworthy.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Pluto: Love is all or nothing. Feelings are intense and possessive, attractions have a fated quality, and relationships bring deep change.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Pluto: The affections are deep and lasting. There is personal magnetism, and love has the power to renew.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Pluto: Love is bound up with power. Jealousy, compulsion or a need to control may complicate relationships until the intensity is understood.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Jupiter: Energy on a large scale. There is enterprise, enthusiasm and the capacity for sustained hard work, with a taste for risk.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Jupiter: Effort is well judged and usually rewarded. This is a vigorous, optimistic contact that favours sport, enterprise and timely action.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Jupiter: Energy is spent recklessly. There is restlessness, exaggeration and a tendency to overreach; aimed at a single goal, the drive is formidable.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Saturn: Force is combined with control. This gives endurance and a capacity for hard, disciplined work, along with a sense of driving with the brake on.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Saturn: Energy is rationed and applied where it counts. There is persistence, practical ability and courage of the steady kind.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Saturn: Action is blocked, or expected to be. Effort alternates between pushing too hard and giving up, and frustration can harden into resentment; in time it teaches real stamina.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Uranus: The will is explosive. Action is sudden, independent and hard to predict, courage is not in doubt, and patience is scarce.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Uranus: Energy is put to original use. There is quickness, decisiveness and often mechanical or technical flair.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Uranus: There is a strong need to be free, expressed impulsively. Temper and nerves are on a hair trigger, and haste and risk-taking call for some care.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Neptune: Drive is put at the service of imagination or ideals. Energy fluctuates, and motives are not always clear even to their owner; the arts and causes give it focus.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Neptune: Action is guided by intuition. There is a talent for rhythm, dance or anything demanding both skill and feeling, and energy for helping others.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Neptune: Effort is undermined by uncertainty. Plans dissolve, energy leaks away, and direct confrontation is avoided; a clear and worthwhile aim makes the difference.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Pluto: Tremendous force of will. There is a relentless capacity for effort and an inability to do things by halves, and the power needs a worthy object.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Pluto: Energy runs deep and steady. There is confidence, endurance and the ability to carry large tasks through.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Pluto: The will meets its match. There are power struggles, a temper that builds to eruption, and a temptation to force matters; mastery of this drive is the point.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Saturn: Expansion and caution are yoked together. There is a sober sense of purpose and a capacity to build something substantial over many years.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Saturn: Optimism and realism balance. Judgment is sound, plans are practical, and steady progress follows.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Saturn: Hope and doubt take turns. There is restlessness about one's position in life, and a pattern of advance and check until the two are reconciled.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Uranus: Sudden openings and a love of freedom. There is an appetite for the new and unusual strokes of fortune.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Uranus: Progressive ideas and lucky breaks. Opportunities arrive unexpectedly and are well used.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Uranus: There is restless independence and a taste for the gamble. Opinions are strong, and sudden changes of course come from impatience with any limit.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Neptune: Idealism and imagination are enlarged. There is generosity and a feeling for the mystical, along with a need to keep the feet on the ground.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Neptune: Kindness, faith and imagination flow together. This is a humane and often artistic or religious contact.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Neptune: Idealism runs to excess. There are great expectations and loose arrangements, and a need for realism over money and promises.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Pluto: The drive to achieve is powerful. There is a capacity for leadership, and for remaking one's life on a larger scale.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Pluto: There is constructive ambition and the ability to organise. Resources are found and put to good use.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Pluto: Ambition overreaches. Convictions are pressed on others, and there may be conflict with established authority.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Uranus: The old order and the new are forced together, a mark shared with everyone born in the same year or two. There is both discipline and originality, with tension between them.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Uranus: New ideas are given practical form. Tradition and innovation cooperate, and changes are made in an orderly way.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Uranus: Duty pulls against freedom. Periods of restriction end in sudden breaks, and the task is to change what needs changing without tearing everything down.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Neptune: Ideals are brought down to earth, or the solid things are dissolved. A dream is given structure, and practical matters are approached with some unease.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Neptune: Imagination is disciplined and vision made practical. There is a patient, self-sacrificing streak.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Neptune: The real and the ideal are at odds. Vague fears and doubts need facing squarely, and a sense of duty has to make peace with a longing to escape.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Pluto: Great endurance and seriousness of purpose, shared with a whole age group. Ambition is deep, and hardship is met without complaint.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Pluto: Concentration and persistence. There is a capacity for long, exacting effort and for rebuilding from the foundations.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Pluto: Circumstances press hard. There is a struggle against forces that seem immovable, which breeds toughness and self-denial.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|Neptune: A rare meeting that marks a whole generation with new ideals and new ways of seeing. It is personal only where these two touch the Sun, Moon or angles.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|Neptune: A generational contact: intuition and inspiration combine easily, with a feeling for the progressive and the humane.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|Neptune: A generational contact: ideals and upheavals collide, leaving a restless and uncertain background to the times.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|Pluto: A generation born to radical change. The urge to overturn and renew is strong in the background of the life.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|Pluto: A generational contact: change is absorbed and turned to constructive use.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|Pluto: A generational contact: the times themselves are disruptive, and personal life is shaped by upheaval in the wider world.
aspects.Neptune|Conjunction|Pluto: A very rare conjunction marking the start of a long historical cycle. It belongs to the age rather than to the individual.
aspects.Neptune|Flow|Pluto: Shared by almost everyone born in the same decades: a slow, background deepening of awareness.
aspects.Neptune|Tension|Pluto: A generational contact: collective ideals and collective compulsions pull against each other.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Ascendant: The Sun was rising, or close to it. The personality is strong, vital and hard to overlook, and what is shown to the world is very much what is there.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Ascendant: The inner self and the outward manner are in step, so self-expression is confident and unforced.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Ascendant: The self is expressed with effort, or largely through other people. An opposition here puts the Sun near the Descendant, with partnership at the centre of the life.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Midheaven: Born near noon, with the Sun at the top of the chart. There is a strong drive toward recognition and a public role.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Midheaven: Personal aims and career fit together. Advancement comes without having to act out of character.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Midheaven: What the self wants and what the career or family asks do not line up neatly. An opposition here puts the Sun at the foot of the chart, rooted in private life.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Ascendant: The Moon was rising. Feelings are visible, the manner is receptive and sympathetic, and the mood of the moment shows in the face.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Ascendant: Feelings are expressed naturally, and others respond to the warmth.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Ascendant: Moods get in the way of the impression made. Emotional needs are bound up with close relationships and can make this person dependent on a partner's response.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Midheaven: The feelings are engaged in the career. There is an instinct for the public mood and a need for a calling that matters emotionally.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Midheaven: Instinct helps in work and public dealings, and private and professional life support one another.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Midheaven: Home and career compete for the heart, and the mood of one spills into the other.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Ascendant: Mercury was rising: a talkative, observant, quick-witted manner, always asking and commenting.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Ascendant: Ideas are put across easily, and there is a ready rapport in conversation.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Ascendant: A good deal is said, and not all of it lands as intended. Thinking is done in exchange with others, with some argument along the way.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Midheaven: The mind is turned toward the career. Work is likely to involve words, ideas, trade or travel.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Midheaven: A clear head for professional matters and an ability to speak up to advantage.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Midheaven: There are many changes of mind about direction, and a restless search for work that occupies the intellect.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Ascendant: Venus was rising: an attractive, gracious, sociable manner, with care taken over appearance and a wish to be liked.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Ascendant: Charm and good manners smooth the way in personal contacts.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Ascendant: The wish to please is strong, perhaps too strong. There is much attention to relationships, and an inclination to take the line of least resistance.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Midheaven: Popularity helps the career. The work may be in art, beauty or dealing with the public, and there is a liking for social standing.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Midheaven: Agreeable relations with employers and the public; talents are appreciated.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Midheaven: Affections and ambitions pull in different directions, and comfort may be chosen over effort.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Ascendant: Mars was rising: a forceful, energetic, impatient manner, quick to act and to compete.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Ascendant: Energy is expressed confidently and gets things done without treading on toes.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Ascendant: The manner is combative, or attracts combative people. Disputes with partners and rivals teach how to assert without attacking.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Midheaven: Great energy goes into the career. This is an ambitious, independent worker who wants to be in command.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Midheaven: Energy is well directed toward goals; initiative is noticed and rewarded.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Midheaven: There are clashes with superiors or within the family. Ambition is strong, and impatient of the time it takes.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Ascendant: Jupiter was rising: a jovial, confident, generous manner and a large presence, sometimes in every sense.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Ascendant: An optimistic outlook wins goodwill, and things tend to fall out well.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Ascendant: There is a tendency to promise too much or take too much for granted. Benefits come largely through partners and other people.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Midheaven: A fortunate sign for career and reputation: success, recognition and helpful people in high places.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Midheaven: Opportunities for advancement come readily, and aims are both large and achievable.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Midheaven: Ambitions are outsize. Too much may be expected too soon, in career or in family life.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Ascendant: Saturn was rising: a reserved, serious, cautious manner. Life is met as a responsibility, and ease comes with age.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Ascendant: A steady, responsible manner earns trust, and patience is its own advantage.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Ascendant: There is inhibition in meeting others and a sense of burden in close relationships. Partners may be older or serious, and bonds form slowly.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Midheaven: Ambition is deep and patient. There is a slow climb, with heavy responsibility and a position that must be honestly earned to be kept.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Midheaven: Steady, well-organised progress in the career; dependability is rewarded.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Midheaven: Duties to family or work feel heavy, and recognition is delayed. Persistence is the whole answer.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|Ascendant: Uranus was rising: an unconventional, restless, electric manner. This is a person who surprises people.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|Ascendant: Originality is expressed attractively, and new contacts are stimulating.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|Ascendant: There is a need for independence that unsettles relationships. Partners are unusual and partnerships subject to sudden change.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|Midheaven: The career is unusual and subject to sudden change. Independence in work is essential.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|Midheaven: Original ideas help the career, and changes of direction turn out well.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|Midheaven: There is rebellion against authority and upheavals in career or home. Freedom matters more than position.
aspects.Neptune|Conjunction|Ascendant: Neptune was rising: a dreamy, sensitive, elusive manner, highly impressionable, with a touch of glamour.
aspects.Neptune|Flow|Ascendant: A gentle, sympathetic manner and an intuitive feel for other people.
aspects.Neptune|Tension|Ascendant: There is confusion in dealings with others. People are idealised or misread, and clearer boundaries are needed in partnership.
aspects.Neptune|Conjunction|Midheaven: The calling is artistic, spiritual or idealistic, and the path to it is not straightforward.
aspects.Neptune|Flow|Midheaven: Imagination and intuition are assets in the career.
aspects.Neptune|Tension|Midheaven: There is uncertainty about aims in life. A sense of vocation is longed for and hard to pin down.
aspects.Pluto|Conjunction|Ascendant: Pluto was rising: an intense, penetrating, strong-willed manner. The whole way of meeting the world is remade more than once.
aspects.Pluto|Flow|Ascendant: Personal influence is strong and used constructively.
aspects.Pluto|Tension|Ascendant: Relationships are intense and involve struggles over control. Others are changed by the encounter, and so is this person.
aspects.Pluto|Conjunction|Midheaven: There is a drive for power and a marked public role. The career may be completely transformed.
aspects.Pluto|Flow|Midheaven: Determination and concentration serve the ambitions well.
aspects.Pluto|Tension|Midheaven: There are conflicts with authority and upheaval in career or family, which force a rebuilding from the ground up.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|North Node: The Sun stands with the North Node, so simply being fully oneself is the direction of growth. There is a strong sense of having something to do.
aspects.Sun|Flow|North Node: Character and direction agree. Chances to develop come along and are taken without much inner resistance.
aspects.Sun|Tension|North Node: Pride and habit pull against the direction of growth. At turning points the familiar way of being oneself has to give some ground.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|North Node: Growth comes through the feelings. Learning to trust instinct, and to care and be cared for, is the way ahead.
aspects.Moon|Flow|North Node: The instincts can be relied on to point the right way, and help tends to come from women and from family.
aspects.Moon|Tension|North Node: Emotional habit holds things back. The comfort of the past and the need to move on are at odds, and old attachments are tested.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|North Node: Growth comes through the mind: learning, speaking up and making connections are the road forward.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|North Node: Ideas and conversations arrive at the right time, and a good deal is learned from the people met along the way.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|North Node: Old ways of thinking get in the way of the new direction; opinions need revising as the life moves on.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|North Node: Growth comes through love and the cultivation of what is valued. Important relationships have a sense of rightness about them.
aspects.Venus|Flow|North Node: Affection smooths the path. People are met at fortunate moments, and agreeable ties help things forward.
aspects.Venus|Tension|North Node: What is pleasant and what is needed for growth are not the same. Relationships may have to be outgrown, or chosen more carefully.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|North Node: Growth comes through action and courage. The road forward has to be taken by one's own initiative, sometimes by fighting for it.
aspects.Mars|Flow|North Node: Energy is spent in the right direction; effort and timing work together.
aspects.Mars|Tension|North Node: Impulse cuts across the path. Anger, haste, or acting alone when cooperation was needed are the lessons here.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|North Node: A fortunate contact. Growth comes through faith, learning and generosity, and helpful people appear along the way.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|North Node: Opportunity and direction coincide; the way forward tends to open by itself.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|North Node: There is a temptation to take the easy or the large way round. Beliefs once relied on have to be re-examined.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|North Node: Growth is a matter of duty and time. The way forward is slow and demanding, and brings real authority in the end.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|North Node: Patience serves the long-term direction. Older or more experienced people give useful support.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|North Node: Fear or obligation blocks the path. There are delays, and burdens that have to be either accepted or put down.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|North Node: Growth comes through breaking with the expected. The life takes sudden turns that prove, later, to have been the point.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|North Node: Change comes when it is needed, and the unusual choice turns out to be the right one.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|North Node: Restlessness disrupts the direction. Upheavals arrive from outside, and freedom has to be squared with purpose.
aspects.Neptune|Conjunction|North Node: Growth comes through imagination, compassion or faith. The way ahead is felt rather than mapped.
aspects.Neptune|Flow|North Node: Intuition guides the way gently; there is a feeling for the mood of the times.
aspects.Neptune|Tension|North Node: The direction is easily lost in dreams or evasions. Clarity about what is actually wanted has to be worked for.
aspects.Pluto|Conjunction|North Node: Growth is drastic. The way forward runs through endings and complete renewal, and has a compelled, fated quality.
aspects.Pluto|Flow|North Node: Deep changes come at the right time and serve the long-term direction.
aspects.Pluto|Tension|North Node: Powerful forces, or powerful people, stand across the path. Something has to be given up before the way reopens.
aspects.North Node|Conjunction|Chiron: The direction of growth runs straight through the old wound. Facing it is the path, and helping others with the same hurt becomes part of the purpose.
aspects.North Node|Flow|Chiron: What was learned from difficulty serves the way forward.
aspects.North Node|Tension|Chiron: An old hurt makes the new direction feel unsafe. It has to be tended before the path can be taken freely.
aspects.North Node|Conjunction|Lilith: The way forward means claiming what was once denied or disowned. Growth comes through refusing a role that never fitted.
aspects.North Node|Flow|Lilith: Independence of spirit supports the direction of growth.
aspects.North Node|Tension|Lilith: A defiant streak pulls away from the path, and the urge to refuse everything has to be told apart from real freedom.
aspects.North Node|Conjunction|Ascendant: The path of growth is toward the self: independence, initiative, and a personal identity that owes less to others.
aspects.North Node|Flow|Ascendant: The manner and the direction of life are in step, and the right people tend to turn up.
aspects.North Node|Tension|Ascendant: Growth comes through others, or through home and career, rather than through self-assertion. An opposition here puts the North Node on the Descendant, pointing toward partnership.
aspects.North Node|Conjunction|Midheaven: The path of growth leads into the world. A public role or vocation is a large part of what the life is for.
aspects.North Node|Flow|Midheaven: Career and direction of growth support each other.
aspects.North Node|Tension|Midheaven: The direction of growth cuts across worldly ambition. An opposition here points the North Node toward home and the inner life.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Chiron: The wound is close to the centre of the character: a doubt about one's own worth or right to shine. From it comes a real ability to bring out confidence in others.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Chiron: Old hurts have been made use of. There is an unforced gift for encouraging and mending.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Chiron: Self-confidence carries a sore spot, often connected with the father or with early recognition. It is eased by doing the thing anyway.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Chiron: The feelings carry an early hurt, often around mothering or belonging. Sensitivity to others' pain is acute.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Chiron: A soothing presence: emotional understanding that has grown out of past difficulty.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Chiron: Old emotional pain is easily touched. Needs may be hidden for fear they will not be met.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Chiron: The mind carries the wound, perhaps as a memory of being thought slow or not being listened to. There is skill in teaching and in healing with words.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Chiron: Words that help come easily, as does the understanding of how others learn and what they find hard.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Chiron: There is sensitivity to criticism of what is said or thought, and a sharp eye for the weak point in an argument.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Chiron: Love and hurt arrive together. A sense of not being attractive or lovable enough underlies a real tenderness toward others.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Chiron: Affection heals. There is grace in dealing with other people's vulnerability.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Chiron: Relationships reopen old injuries. Rejection is feared, and worth has to be learned apart from being wanted.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Chiron: The wound is to the will: a hesitation about asserting or defending oneself, which can swing to its opposite. Courage on others' behalf comes easily.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Chiron: Energy is readily put to work for healing or repair.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Chiron: Anger and vulnerability are tangled. Action may be held back by old defeats, or overdone to hide them.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Chiron: A gift for giving hope. Faith has been won through difficulty, and wisdom comes from the wound.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Chiron: Generosity of spirit toward suffering; good at teaching what was learned the hard way.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Chiron: Faith is shaken, or inflated to cover a hurt. Meaning has to be found that does not deny the pain.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Chiron: The burden is an old one and is carried seriously. Difficulty with authority or with a sense of failure matures into quiet strength.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Chiron: Patience with pain: an ability to give structure and steadiness where it hurts.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Chiron: Hard circumstances press on the sore place. Self-criticism is the thing to watch.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|Chiron: The sense of being different is itself the wound, and the gift. This is shared with others born in the same few years.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|Chiron: Unorthodox approaches to healing come naturally; the outsider's view is put to good use.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|Chiron: There is restlessness around old hurts, with sudden breaks made to get away from them. This is shared with a whole age group.
aspects.Neptune|Conjunction|Chiron: Great sensitivity to suffering in general, shared with those born in the same years. It finds an outlet in art, care or faith.
aspects.Neptune|Flow|Chiron: Compassion is easily felt and gently expressed.
aspects.Neptune|Tension|Chiron: The wish to rescue, or to be rescued, confuses matters. Sympathy needs limits.
aspects.Pluto|Conjunction|Chiron: The wound goes to the root and demands transformation. This mark is shared by a whole age group.
aspects.Pluto|Flow|Chiron: A capacity for deep healing and for recovery after crisis.
aspects.Pluto|Tension|Chiron: Old pain is bound up with power and its misuse. Facing it is drastic and worth doing.
aspects.Chiron|Conjunction|Lilith: What was wounded and what was shut out lie close together. Healing means taking back a part of the self that was refused.
aspects.Chiron|Flow|Lilith: Instinct and the capacity to heal support each other.
aspects.Chiron|Tension|Lilith: Hurt and defiance feed one another, and the temptation is to refuse help.
aspects.Chiron|Conjunction|Ascendant: The wound is visible, in the body or the manner. Others sense both the vulnerability and the capacity to help.
aspects.Chiron|Flow|Ascendant: A sympathetic manner that puts troubled people at ease.
aspects.Chiron|Tension|Ascendant: Old hurts are stirred in close relationships. Partners may be wounded, or healers, or both.
aspects.Chiron|Conjunction|Midheaven: The vocation has to do with healing, teaching or mending. Standing in public brings the wound into view.
aspects.Chiron|Flow|Midheaven: What was learned through difficulty serves the career.
aspects.Chiron|Tension|Midheaven: A sense of inadequacy attaches to career or family expectations, and success is redefined along the way.
aspects.Sun|Conjunction|Lilith: The character has an untamed, uncompromising core. There is a refusal to be what others expect, and a strong personal magnetism.
aspects.Sun|Flow|Lilith: Instinct and identity are on good terms: the wilder side is accepted and gives confidence.
aspects.Sun|Tension|Lilith: Something in the nature will not be governed by the will. There is a quarrel between who one means to be and what one actually wants.
aspects.Moon|Conjunction|Lilith: The feelings are raw and absolute. There is a fierce need for emotional freedom, and an uneasy relationship with nurturing and being nurtured.
aspects.Moon|Flow|Lilith: The instincts are trusted, and the darker feelings are admitted rather than feared.
aspects.Moon|Tension|Lilith: Emotional needs and the refusal to depend on anyone collide. Moods can be stormy, and are honest.
aspects.Mercury|Conjunction|Lilith: The mind is provocative and unafraid. What others leave unsaid is said, sometimes with a cutting edge.
aspects.Mercury|Flow|Lilith: Instinct informs the thinking, and there is ease in talking about difficult or forbidden things.
aspects.Mercury|Tension|Lilith: Words are used to shock or to resist. The mind argues against being told.
aspects.Venus|Conjunction|Lilith: Attraction is magnetic and unconventional. Love refuses to be tamed, and there is a powerful, unapologetic sensuality.
aspects.Venus|Flow|Lilith: Desire and affection are at ease with each other; a natural allure.
aspects.Venus|Tension|Lilith: The wish to please and the refusal to be owned are in conflict. Relationships have a push and pull.
aspects.Mars|Conjunction|Lilith: Drive is raw and instinctive. Desire and anger are strong and direct, and nothing is done by permission.
aspects.Mars|Flow|Lilith: Instinct gives force to action; there is courage in defying what is unjust.
aspects.Mars|Tension|Lilith: Will and instinct clash. Rage at being controlled is the thing to understand, and to use rather than suffer.
aspects.Jupiter|Conjunction|Lilith: The appetite for freedom is large, and there is a taste for excess and for breaking taboos in the name of truth.
aspects.Jupiter|Flow|Lilith: Independence of spirit is rewarded; beliefs make room for instinct.
aspects.Jupiter|Tension|Lilith: Too much is wanted, too freely. Principles and appetites argue.
aspects.Saturn|Conjunction|Lilith: Instinct is held under strict control, or meets a wall. There is a serious, lonely strength in refusing to give way.
aspects.Saturn|Flow|Lilith: The untamed side is given discipline, and so becomes useful.
aspects.Saturn|Tension|Lilith: Authority and instinct are at war. What is repressed returns as resentment until it is given a place.
aspects.Uranus|Conjunction|Lilith: Rebellion is doubled. There is a radical insistence on freedom, and a refusal of every label.
aspects.Uranus|Flow|Lilith: Originality and instinct combine; nonconformity comes without strain.
aspects.Uranus|Tension|Lilith: Defiance turns erratic. There are breaks with convention that are sudden and total.
aspects.Neptune|Conjunction|Lilith: Instinct is veiled in fantasy. There is a fascination with the forbidden, and with glamour and longing.
aspects.Neptune|Flow|Lilith: Imagination draws on deep instinctive sources.
aspects.Neptune|Tension|Lilith: Desire and illusion are hard to tell apart, and what is refused may be idealised.
aspects.Pluto|Conjunction|Lilith: The most intense form of this point: compelling desire, a will that cannot be coerced, and a familiarity with what others avoid.
aspects.Pluto|Flow|Lilith: Deep instinct can be drawn on as a source of power and renewal.
aspects.Pluto|Tension|Lilith: Power struggles touch the rawest nerve. Control, in either direction, is the issue.
aspects.Lilith|Conjunction|Ascendant: The untamed quality is worn openly: a provocative, magnetic presence that will not be told how to behave.
aspects.Lilith|Flow|Ascendant: An instinctive self-possession shows in the manner.
aspects.Lilith|Tension|Ascendant: The refusal to be controlled is met in relationships. Partners carry it, or provoke it.
aspects.Lilith|Conjunction|Midheaven: The public role has something defiant in it: a reputation for independence, or a calling outside what is approved.
aspects.Lilith|Flow|Midheaven: Independence of spirit serves the career.
aspects.Lilith|Tension|Midheaven: There is a refusal of the expected place in the world, or in the family, and a struggle with whoever defines it.

aspectNotes.Conjunction: These energies blend and amplify each other.
aspectNotes.Sextile: An easy, supportive link that offers opportunity when used.
aspectNotes.Square: Friction here pushes growth through effort and challenge.
aspectNotes.Trine: A natural, effortless flow of talent between the two.
aspectNotes.Opposition: A push-pull that seeks balance between opposite needs.
aspectNotes.SemiSextile: A minor aspect: neighbouring signs with little in common, a mild and easily missed friction.
aspectNotes.SemiSquare: A minor aspect: a low-level irritation, half a square, that nags rather than confronts.
aspectNotes.Sesquiquadrate: A minor aspect: a square and a half, an agitation that tends to surface under pressure.
aspectNotes.Quincunx: A minor aspect: the two have nothing in common by sign, so neither can simply have its way.
aspectNotes.Quintile: A minor aspect: a fifth of the circle, traditionally read as a talent or a knack that asks to be used.
aspectNotes.Biquintile: A minor aspect: two fifths of the circle, read like the quintile as a skill, here one that comes with practice.

elements.Fire: a fiery temperament — driven, enthusiastic, and quick to act
elements.Earth: an earthy temperament — practical, grounded, and reliable
elements.Air: an airy temperament — intellectual, social, and idea-driven
elements.Water: a watery temperament — emotional, intuitive, and empathetic

modalities.Cardinal: an initiating temperament — active, enterprising, and quick to start things in motion
modalities.Fixed: a steadfast temperament — persistent, determined, and slow to change course
modalities.Mutable: an adaptable temperament — flexible, versatile, and at ease with change

_balance_comment: Fuller text for the two balance sections. elementStrong / modalityStrong follow the 'leans toward' sentence; elementWeak / modalityWeak are used for each element or modality with no bodies in it; balanceNotes cover an even spread.

elementStrong.Fire: With this much fire there is no shortage of confidence or initiative. Life is approached as something to be acted on, and enthusiasm does much of the work that planning does for other people. The cost is impatience, and a tendency to burn through energy and interest alike.
elementStrong.Earth: With this much earth, reality is what can be seen, measured and used. There is patience, common sense and a gift for making things actually work. The cost is a certain heaviness: a reluctance to trust what cannot be proved, or to move until the ground is sure.
elementStrong.Air: With this much air, life is lived in ideas, words and relationships. There is objectivity, fairness and a need to understand and to be in contact. The cost is distance: it is easier to discuss a feeling than to have it, and plans can stay plans.
elementStrong.Water: With this much water, feeling is the main way of knowing. There is sympathy, imagination and an instinct for what lies under the surface. The cost is vulnerability to moods, one's own and other people's, and difficulty standing far enough back to see clearly.

elementWeak.Fire: No body is in a fire sign. Confidence and spontaneity may not come by themselves; enthusiasm has to be kindled deliberately, or is borrowed from fierier people. A strongly placed Sun or Mars can make up much of the difference.
elementWeak.Earth: No body is in an earth sign. The practical side of life — money, routine, the body's needs — may feel like foreign territory, and has to be attended to on purpose. Such people often either ignore it or overcompensate.
elementWeak.Air: No body is in an air sign. Standing back to look at things objectively does not come naturally, and it can be hard to put experience into words or to see the other point of view without effort.
elementWeak.Water: No body is in a water sign. Feelings are there, as they are for everyone, but they are not easily reached or shown, and other people's emotions can be puzzling. Sympathy has to be learned as a skill.

modalityStrong.Cardinal: This is a chart that needs a project. Energy goes into starting things, taking charge of circumstances and meeting problems head-on, and standing still feels like going backwards. Seeing matters through to the end is the harder part.
modalityStrong.Fixed: This is a chart with staying power. Once a direction is set it is held, through opposition and long after others have given up, and loyalties and habits are just as durable. Flexibility is the harder part; change, when it comes, comes all at once.
modalityStrong.Mutable: This is a chart that bends rather than breaks. There is a quickness to adjust, to see several sides and to fit in with whatever the moment asks. Holding to one course, and knowing which of the many possibilities to choose, is the harder part.

modalityWeak.Cardinal: No body is in a cardinal sign, so getting things started may take a push from outside. The talent is for carrying on or adapting rather than for striking out.
modalityWeak.Fixed: No body is in a fixed sign, so persistence is not a given. Interest and effort are apt to move on before the results are in, and a steadying routine or partner helps.
modalityWeak.Mutable: No body is in a mutable sign, so adapting is hard work. The nature is definite and purposeful, and tends to meet changed circumstances by pushing harder rather than by bending.

balanceNotes.elementsEven: The four elements are evenly represented, so no one way of meeting life dominates: there is some capacity for action, for practicality, for thought and for feeling alike.
balanceNotes.modalitiesEven: The three modes are evenly represented: this person can begin things, sustain them and adapt them in roughly equal measure.

_patterns_comment: Text for the Chart Patterns section, each added after the line naming the pattern. stelliumSigns is keyed by sign, grandTrines by element, tSquares and grandCrosses by modality. apexPoints, keyed by planet or angle, says what it means for that point to stand at the apex of a T-square or yod.

stelliumSigns.Aries: So much in Aries makes for a headlong, self-starting character: a need to act independently and to be first, and little talent for waiting.
stelliumSigns.Taurus: So much in Taurus makes for a deeply rooted character: strong on patience, loyalty and the pleasures of the senses, and immovable once settled.
stelliumSigns.Gemini: So much in Gemini makes for a restless, many-sided mind: always learning, talking and connecting, with more interests than hours.
stelliumSigns.Cancer: So much in Cancer centres the life on feeling, family and belonging: a protective, retentive nature that is strongly tied to its past.
stelliumSigns.Leo: So much in Leo makes for a large, warm, proud personality with a strong need to create, to lead and to be recognised.
stelliumSigns.Virgo: So much in Virgo concentrates on work, skill and getting things right: an analytical, conscientious nature that is hard on itself.
stelliumSigns.Libra: So much in Libra turns the life toward other people: toward partnership, fairness and beauty, with decisions weighed and reweighed.
stelliumSigns.Scorpio: So much in Scorpio gives unusual intensity and privacy: strong desires, great willpower, and a need to live at depth.
stelliumSigns.Sagittarius: So much in Sagittarius makes for a wide-ranging, freedom-loving character, hungry for experience, meaning and distance.
stelliumSigns.Capricorn: So much in Capricorn makes for a serious, ambitious, self-reliant character, with a strong sense of duty and of time.
stelliumSigns.Aquarius: So much in Aquarius makes for an independent, idea-driven character, more at home with principles and groups than with convention.
stelliumSigns.Pisces: So much in Pisces makes for a highly sensitive, imaginative character, open to everything, and in need of a refuge.

grandTrines.Fire: In fire it gives effortless confidence and vitality — faith in oneself that seldom has to be argued for.
grandTrines.Earth: In earth it gives a natural competence with material things — practical security seems to arrange itself.
grandTrines.Air: In air it gives fluency with ideas and people — understanding and communication without strain.
grandTrines.Water: In water it gives emotional depth and intuition — a rich, self-contained inner life.

tSquares.Cardinal: In cardinal signs the tension is discharged in action: there is always a crisis to meet or a new start to make.
tSquares.Fixed: In fixed signs the tension is held: great determination, and great resistance to changing a course once set.
tSquares.Mutable: In mutable signs the tension scatters: nervous energy, changes of plan, and a need to concentrate on one thing.

grandCrosses.Cardinal: In cardinal signs it produces ceaseless activity: many things begun at once, pulling four ways.
grandCrosses.Fixed: In fixed signs it produces immense endurance and an equally immense stubbornness: nothing moves until everything does.
grandCrosses.Mutable: In mutable signs it produces restlessness and versatility: a life of constant adjustment in search of a centre.

apexPoints.Sun: With the Sun at the apex, the pressure falls on the sense of identity and purpose: the whole pattern asks who this person is going to be.
apexPoints.Moon: With the Moon at the apex, the pressure is felt emotionally, in moods, in the home, and in the need for security.
apexPoints.Mercury: With Mercury at the apex, the pressure goes into the mind and the nerves, and is worked out by thinking, talking and deciding.
apexPoints.Venus: With Venus at the apex, the pressure falls on relationships and on what is valued and loved.
apexPoints.Mars: With Mars at the apex, the pressure comes out as action, and sometimes as anger: this is a pattern that has to do something.
apexPoints.Jupiter: With Jupiter at the apex, the pressure seeks release through expansion: more scope, more risk, more meaning.
apexPoints.Saturn: With Saturn at the apex, the pressure meets a wall. It is felt as duty, limitation or fear, and is answered by long, patient work.
apexPoints.Uranus: With Uranus at the apex, the pressure breaks out suddenly, as rebellion or a sharp change of direction.
apexPoints.Neptune: With Neptune at the apex, the pressure tends to dissolve into confusion, escape or sacrifice, unless it is given an imaginative or spiritual outlet.
apexPoints.Pluto: With Pluto at the apex, the pressure builds toward crisis and complete change: something has to be ended for something else to begin.
apexPoints.Ascendant: With the Ascendant at the apex, the pressure shows in the person directly, in the body, the manner and the way of meeting others.
apexPoints.Midheaven: With the Midheaven at the apex, the pressure is worked out in public, through career and standing.
